question: The time taken by a 180 m long train running at a speed of 54 km/h to cross a man standing on the platform is:
solution:
**Given:**

Length of train = 180 m

Speed of train = 54 km/h

**Concept Used:**

Speed = (Distance)/(Time)

**Calculation:**

Firstly, we will change the value of speed from km/h to m/s.

⇒ 54 km/h = 54times (5)/(18)

⇒ 54 km/h = 15 m/s

Putting the value in the speed formula, we get

⇒ 15 m/s = (180)/(Time)

⇒ Time = (180)/(15)

⇒ Time = 12 seconds

**∴ The time taken by the train to cross a man standing on the platform is 12 seconds.**
